title: AI Is Keeping Global Growth Afloat, but a Debt Trap Is Closing In, IMF Warns
description: Artificial intelligence is keeping global growth resilient, but soaring debt, rising borrowing costs and renewed inflation pressures are eroding governments’ capacity to withstand future shocks. The IMF warns that technological gains alone cannot restore financial stability as economic divides widen and fiscal buffers shrink.

title: One decision that made Jensen Huang worth $185 billion: Nvidia nearly went bankrupt in 1996, then a risky bet helped build its AI dominance
description: Jensen Huang went from working as a dishwasher at Dennys to becoming the billionaire CEO of Nvidia. The turning point came in 1993, when he cofounded the company with two engineers to develop chips for better computer graphics. After an early setback nearly bankrupted Nvidia, Huang backed graphics-processing technology that later became essential to artificial intelligence, helping transform the company into a global technology powerhouse.

title: For scammers, the deepfake is now a working tool
description: OVER about a year, a dentist in Tarlac handed P93 million to people she believed were working with the president. What convinced her was a video. On screen, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. looked to be endorsing the investment himself, his face and voice convincing enough that she believed it. But none of it was real. The video was a deepfake, made with artificial intelligence (AI). In October 2025, police arrested two suspects in Angeles City, Pampanga.
